scope:
Score Chase: shipping DOM, input handlers, audio and model. Controlled fixtures
exercise record provenance and extreme HUD states; not human enjoyment research.
Transport adapts only assets/module URLs and the existing explicit debug guard.

tests.name: Exact 3.5.2 runtime: one integrated score panel, visible even in focused HUD
First run remains FIRST RUN after scoring; no fake zero target or premature save
Running total and frozen baseline remain exact when stored best changes mid-attempt
90 percent is a soft state; equal score is not a record
Real Enter crossing: +30, one restrained pulse/sound, frozen target and uninterrupted typing
A genuine recorded zero is distinguishable from no record
Reduced motion removes movement; high contrast keeps explicit NEW BEST text
Changing reduced motion during a live celebration cancels score motion immediately
Pause/resume preserves frozen target and does not replay its celebration
Next-run difficulty settings and detailed HUD do not retarget an active Classic run
Mute cancels pending record sound; unmute never replays or duplicates it
A nonzero chapter opening does not turn running SCORE into the chapter subtotal
Real final-word + chapter bonus is reflected and saved; original star explanation stays intact
First clear records the score without moving its target; practice Retry picks up the saved best
Campaign Next keeps accumulated score and captures the next chapter’s own frozen total target
Campaign game-over commits only the ended attempt; Retry restores score and refreshes the target
Endless keeps one target across wave transitions, not a moving per-wave target
Retiring Endless saves the running target for the next run
Continuing an earlier ruleset shows its score but never compares to current-rule PBs
Continue captures the checkpoint chapter, pace and actual cumulative score without replay
Save import cannot retarget a live chase; the next attempt sees the imported higher best
Score layout, resizing and contrast changes leave the complete model snapshot untouched
Score ticks do not spam the live region; static accessible scope and one record announcement
Viewport 1920×1080: first/best/new-best/extreme scores fit, chapter and WIND spacing intact
